work_experience.description: Optimized custom proxy services for scraping integrations, ensuring secure QR-based payment processing and seamless terminal-to-cloud communication. Engineered SoftPOS integrations to streamline order transactions and enhance mobile payment capabilities. Developed automated web scraping pipelines to synchronize merchant data, significantly reducing manual onboarding time and improving data integrity. Implemented MCP (Model Context Protocol) to facilitate secure database integrations, enabling AI models to perform real-time queries against live data environments.

Designed integration layers to bridge QR payment platforms with third-party Point of Sale (POS) systems utilizing REST APIs and Webhook architectures. Developed robust SQL-based database bridges to synchronize transaction data between payment platforms and merchant POS systems. Served as an SRE Support Developer, resolving high-priority production incidents through cross-functional collaboration with customer success and Site Reliability Engineering teams.

projects.name: Robust and Trustworthy Fraud Transaction Detection
projects.description: Designing a unified financial risk defense architecture incorporating an adversarial robust fraud detection model, a behavioral credit risk drift model, and an explainable cross channel pipeline. Developing advanced data engineering strategies and mapping synthetic environments to support robust, multi-channel fraud detection training. Researching adaptive and explainable machine learning approaches to ensure the model s transparency and resilience against evolving financial threats.

projects.name: AI-Native Spec-Driven Development Pipeline
projects.description: Designed and implemented an AI-native, spec-driven development pipeline that transforms structured feature specifications into production ready code, tests, and deployment artifacts using Google Gemini API. Containerized the system with Docker and docker compose, implemented CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and added agent orchestration with intelligent retry logic and pipeline health evaluation metrics.

projects.name: Qlub QR Payment and POS Integrations
projects.description: Engineered integration layers bridging Qlub s QR payment platform with third-party Point of Sale (POS)/SoftPos systems utilizing REST APIs, Webhooks, and SQL database bridges. Built robust web scraping pipelines to automate merchant data synchronization, significantly reducing manual onboarding time and ensuring data integrity. Developed custom proxy services to facilitate secure QR based payment processing and terminal-to-cloud communication. Resolved high-priority production incidents by providing robust SRE support and collaborating cross-functionally with customer handling and Site Reliability teams.

projects.name: ApartFlow (Residence Management System)
projects.description: Developed a full-stack Residence Management System under Creative Software mentorship to streamline daily administrative, financial, and operational tasks. Built a cross-platform resident portal and management dashboard, integrating PayHere for secure fee processing and seamless resident-staff communication.

projects.name: Green Haven
projects.description: Developed a full-featured e-commerce platform for a plant shop with separate customer and admin interfaces. Built a customer portal with product browsing, cart management, secure checkout, and real-time order tracking. Implemented an admin dashboard for product/category management, order monitoring, and performance insights. Integrated Stripe for secure payment processing and transactions. Designed a microservices-based architecture , with OAuth authentication and Redis-based session management.
